note: The build-and-drop gestures (PLAN-UNIFY U2d; his word 10-13 on the Dubstep spell's bass out built into its drop: 'awesome, this is exactly what we needed, and likely need more, as in generated music, variety is a saving straw'). Every build the arrangement's phrases lay into a line (src/phrasing.ts: a sub-segment's re-entry, a bass out's last bar, a cooldown's into its break) plays one of these rows, drawn per moment off a stream of its own, leaned by the birds, never the same kind twice in a row within a theme, and bigger into a bigger arrival. The rows are the vocabulary; src/phrasing.ts is the interpreter. A row names roles, steps, levels, beats and dB, never a voice: every hit it writes is a copy of a hit the theme's own kit already plays (src/subsections.ts), and its fx are the glue's own voices only where the theme already sounds them, so no row ever adds an instrument. Every number is a starting point for listening.

units.says: what each knob counts (src/musical-time.ts): beats and sixteenths of the theme's bar, a weight relative, a lean the one lean's (src/lean.ts) about `centre` (the house's own birds, so the house plays the weights as written), dB absolute. A pattern is sixteenths (one per length of the window where it names them by beats, else cut from the left): the lead's sits on the bar's grid ending on the line, the stop taking its tail; an added lane's ends where the window ends (the stop's first step, or the line). A digit is a hit at that many tenths of the copied hit's level (at most 7 on a lead: a build never peaks over its lane), `C` the open hat at 0.7 choked where the window ends, `.` a rest. `rest` lanes go quiet from the window's start (the kick never before the last bar's half, and the open hat never where it is the closed hats' own voice); the `lead` lane, the first of its lanes the kit plays (never a part's), is cleared from there and plays its pattern; `lanes` add their patterns. Two bars only where the bar before is the section's and no other small thing's, and never over a track row's own drums. `bass`: out from the window's start, out from the stop, or gated with the field. A field cut over the stop (the phrasing row's `build.stopDb`) unless the row cuts its whole window

centre.says: the house's own birds (src/spell.ts HOUSE): every lean below is nought there, and every sound of the table below is the house's own

choice.says: how a moment's gesture is drawn among the rows the kit admits there: a row's `weight`, times its size's weight for the arrival (`big`: a drop or a main's return after a break, a build or a drop; `small`: a phrase's line inside a main, a cooldown into its break), times its bird leans, times `repeat` where it is the theme's previous build's kind (never twice in a row, unless it is the only one the moment admits) and `recent` where the theme already played it; then its length among the row's `beats`, the longer leaned by the birds (`sound.roll.length`, per doubling) and up into a big arrival (`longer.big`, per doubling); then its stop among the row's `stop` (sixteenths of silence before the line, the longer leaned by `sound.stop.length`); then its landing

landings.says: how the drop lands on the line: `stroke`, the theme's own crash or impact on the one (named as it sounds; a gesture the arrangement already lands there is the stroke); `kick`, the kick alone through the line's first beat (the backbeat, the hats, the tops and the field back on its second beat, the bass's first note moved to it); `bass`, the kick and the bass alone through the first beat, the bass struck at the line's top velocity, everything else back on the second beat. A landing the line cannot take (a crash the palette lacks; the line a bar the house's own small things mark; the bass gliding into the line, for `kick`) is not drawn; with none left everything is back at once. Into a big arrival the stroke weighs `big.stroke` times

sound.says: **How each gesture sounds by the birds** (his word 10-13 on U2d's pairs: 'these effects should account for birds positions as well'; on the reverse at the Dubstep spell: 'fine probably for classic house or trance, but for dubstep a bit too bright'). The one table: per parameter, what it moves (`of`), the gestures it moves (`kinds`, every one where none is named), its `unit`, and per bird the move per unit of the bird about `centre` (the house's own birds; the producer's builds take theirs about the fast place's own, its row's `gestures.centre`), summed over the birds and held to `range`. Nought at the centre, where nothing is written: the house plays as it did. `octaves`: the sound's own frequency times two to the sum; `lean`: its own times e to the sum (`roll.length` per doubling of the window, `stop.length` per beat of the stop, as the one lean leans a weight); `dB`: plus the sum; `share`: of the roll's hits (above nought its rests filled before the line, the latest first, each at the lower of its neighbours; below, every other hit of its earliest share thinned, its last beat kept). The birds keep their meanings: Root the body (heavier, darker, a longer silence and a bigger landing), Spark the movement (brighter, denser rolls, shorter stops), Veil the effects' rate (a brighter, wider sweep), Zephyr the air's brightness, Tide the space (a longer, wetter tail), Loom the form (the longer windows)

filtered.cut.of: the low-pass a build's phrase is cut to (a filtered phrase's, a half-time phrase's, an out's; its row's own at nought, never brighter: the bright side keeps the house's cut)

filtered.open.of: how far under the line's own the low-pass opening with the build reaches where the window ends, the line's own on the line (all the way at nought)

reverse.band.of: the reverse swell's noise band at the line (the voice's own at nought)

reverse.sweep.of: how far under its band at the line the reverse swell's band starts, opening into it (fixed at nought)

whoosh.hp.of: the whoosh's high-pass top where the stop starts (its row's `fx.hpHz` at nought)

riser.band.of: the top of the riser's climbing band under a build (the voice's own at nought)

glue.tail.of: the riser's and the reverse swell's fall after the line

glue.wet.of: the riser's and the reverse swell's sends against their direct sound (the direct held)

roll.length.of: a longer window's weight, per doubling of it

stop.length.of: a longer stop's weight, per beat of it

landing.size.of: the landing's stroke on the line (the crash or the impact)

crash.bright.of: the landing crash's low-pass, under the open 16 kHz

crash.decay.of: the landing crash's ring (its own at nought; never longer)

rows.name: a snare roll
rows.says: the backbeat rolling into the line, eighths then sixteenths, its level climbing to 0.7 of the backbeat's own hit; the hats rest under it

rows.name: a hat roll into a choked open hat
rows.says: the closed hats rolling into the line (the sixteenths where the kit has no hats to roll), the open hat struck on the roll's last sixteenth and choked where the window ends

rows.name: the kick doubling into the line
rows.says: the kick from quarters to eighths to sixteenths into the line, at most 0.7 of its own hit; the tops rest under it, the closed hats and the backbeat play on

rows.name: a stutter, the mix chopped in sixteenths
rows.says: the last beat chopped in sixteenths across the mix: the backbeat (else the kick) struck flat on every sixteenth, the kick on the eighths, the field and the bass gated on and off each sixteenth; no stop, the gate is the stop

rows.name: a whoosh, the high-pass sweeping up
rows.says: a fast high-pass sweep up across the mix (every pitched note sounding over the window, the bass with it, rising evenly in octaves to its top where the stop starts, gone on the line) into the line, the glue's riser over it where the theme sounds one; the drums whole under it, the kick on, and a lift: a figure on the backbeat (else the closed hats, else the sixteenths) climbing over the line's last bar into the stop, whatever the sweep's length; only where the kick plays there (never the sweep alone), each hit a copy of the lane's own where it plays none (his ear 10-13 on the house's whoosh: 'effect is okay, but without drum support a bit flat')

rows.name: a full stop, one hit on the and
rows.says: everything silent for the last beat (or the last two), every drum lane as the stop silences it, one backbeat hit (else the kick's) on the and of four at 0.7 of the lane's own, then the drop; the field cut deep through the silence

rows.name: a reverse cymbal into the line
rows.says: the glue's reverse swell rising over the window into the line, the hats and the tops resting under it, the kick and the backbeat playing on; no stop (the swell rides the field's bus, and a stop's cut would choke it at its peak)
